data.name: Devil Chaser
data.detailed_description:
THE ULTIMATE 1V1 SLOBBERKNOCKER! IT'S DEVIL CHASER!

It's 2004, and the mysterious DR. PSYKOMAN has turned the entire population of the United States of America into DEVILS: cartoony manifestations of a human's inner desires. Why would this madman do this?! Why, to create the greatest television known to man, of course! Choose a Devil, and compete in PSYKOMAN'S game for the ULTIMATE Stardom!

ARENA COMBAT LIKE NO OTHER

Beat the hell out your friends, Off and Online!

A combination of SHMUP, Platformer, Arena Shooter, and Hack and Slash! Master our free-flowing movement and use it to pull off insane maneuvers, attacks, and combos! There are six playstyles to learn: The rapid-fire Lil' Troublemaker; the space controlling Devil Spreader; the explosive Dog Bomber; The home-run hitting Bitch Hitter; the precise trappery of the Lawn Dart; and the advanced maneuverability of the Katana. Your movement dramatically alters each playstyle, giving each a completely unique feel!

EIGHT KILLER MODES

To name some: we got deathmatch with Showdown! A game show-esque brawl to get the most cash in Mega Money Match! A viscious score attack with C.H.U.M.P. Some single player action with Break Stuff, where you see how many cameras you can smash in a set amount of time! We also have CUSTOM modifiers, so you can create your own insane game types!

TONS OF INSANE STAGES

We have loads of varied environments that'll put your improvisational skills to the test! We run the gamut, from more straightforward stages for pure dueling, to hazard-ridden hellholes that'll put your platforming skills to the test! All backed by BANGIN' tunes from composers HIGHBALL and Olumedli!

ZANY CHARACTER SKINS

Tired of boring lumps of dough to play as in your multiplayer games? Check out OUR massive cast of wacky weirdos. None of them affect gameplay, so choose what character you identify with the most! You can further deck out your characters with unlockable costumes!

DOUBLE THE DEVILS, DOUBLE THE VALUE

Buying one copy of the game gives you a SECOND copy you can share with a friend!

data.short_description: LET THE DEVIL OUT! It's 1v1 multiplayer madness! Choose from six unique play styles and compete in a variety of modes and stages against your friends, on or offline! Master our madcap mechanics and free-flowing movement! Share the chaos with a friend: buying one copy gets you one extra!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD FX-4100, Snapdragon X Elite
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 510 (Skylake), AMD Radeon R5 Graphics (Kaveri)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD FX-4100, Snapdragon X Elite
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 (Pascal), AMD Radeon RX 460 (GCN 4.0)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2020
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD FX-4100, Raspberry Pi 4
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Example: Intel HD Graphics 2500 (Ivy Bridge), AMD Radeon R5 Graphics (Kaveri)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2020
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K, AMD Ryzen 5 1600, Raspberry Pi 5 with overclocking
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 (Pascal), AMD Radeon RX 460 (GCN 4.0)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
